name: zk
description: Shared markdown-source zettelkasten with a derived SQLite/FTS/vector index. Creates, updates, searches, and recalls project/user notes.

action.description: Operation to perform. Defaults to search_hybrid.

db.description: Optional derived SQLite index path for search_hybrid/reindex. Defaults to STRAP_ZK_DB or STRAP_WORK/zettel/zettel.sqlite.

scope.description: Markdown source scope. Defaults to user for writes and all for reads.

id.description: Note id for get, update, or delete.

title.description: Note title for create or update.

body.description: Markdown note body for create or update.
